description:
Due 2026-11-09.

* Browser test of the TC1 flow in the UI (session list -> run stream -> approval -> PR link -> run record -> metrics).
* `docs/demo-runbook.md`: minute-by-minute script per scenario, fallback recordings, what to say at each human gate.
* `scripts/reset-demo.ps1`: reset tickets/labels, delete agent branches and PRs on the mirrors, clear sessions.
* Three rehearsals of TC1 (with claude), issues filed as bugs.

## Acceptance

Runbook merged; one full rehearsal recorded end to end without manual fixes.

Then the demo runbook, then E2E browser tests once cline's UI lands.
